instruction.name: fldgt.s
instruction.description: Floating-point bound-checked load, condition rj > rk.

cases.name: base operand through an ALU operation

experiments.name: base operand path

latencies.notes: Latency from the base operand rj to the destination. The loaded value is turned back into an address with add.d (or add.d plus movfr2gr for the floating-point loads), and those helper cycles are subtracted.

experiments.name: index/bound operand path

latencies.notes: Latency from the index or bound operand rk to the destination. The loaded value is the operand itself, so no ALU step is needed; a second case puts andi/xori in the path, which adds one cycle.

throughput.notes: 8 independent lanes: 7.98 core cycles per 8 instructions, CPI 1. Slope method (--unroll 1000, --unroll2 2000).

notes: Latency measured per source operand on LA464: base operand rj -> destination 5 cycles, index/bound operand rk -> destination 4 cycles when the loaded value feeds the address generation directly, and one cycle more when an ALU operation sits in the path. The 64-byte-aligned buffer holds 8 and 0 so the chase stays inside one cache line. Re-derived with the two-cycle cross-domain calibration: movfr2gr and movgr2fr are 2 cycles each, movgr2frh.w is 3, the flag pair is 7/15, vpickve2gr is 3, xvpickve2gr is 5, and vreplgr2vr/xvreplgr2vr are 2 (3 for the byte and half-word broadcast).
